coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: At the variable-category level, 3 of 7 ground-truth items are matched (43%): adversarial versus non-adversarial training regimes, differing game rules, and reasoning-benchmark performance. The latter two matches are incomplete in their details.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output substitutes Llama-3-8B/Mistral-7B for LLaMA-2-7B/Baichuan-2-13B. It does not specify the required fixed dataset splits, batch size 128, or sequence length 2048. Learning rates and KL coefficients are not varied across the specified training methods, and the Alpaca SFT baseline is absent. Most required benchmarks and the geometric mean are missing. Gameplay diagnostics do not explicitly measure attacker-versus-defender win rates or non-adversarial success rates. The Taboo formulation also introduces a cooperative guessing team and an additional adversary rather than faithfully specifying the intended adversarial setup.
